title: Literature Focus Section 2: Multiple Choice and True/False Questions on As You Like It Extracts
summary: A set of comprehension exercises for As You Like It extracts, including five multiple-choice questions about missing characters, Hisperia's beliefs and Frederick's orders, followed by eight true/false statements covering Touchstone's jokes, disguise details and Silvius' view of love.

title: As You Like It Section 2: Old English Vocabulary, Summary Completion and Creative Writing
summary: This page pairs old English phrases with their modern equivalents from the extracts, asks learners to complete a summary of the scene using modern English words, and prompts a creative paragraph imagining Rosalind sharing her feelings with Silvius.

title: Literature Focus Section 3: True/False, Event Ordering and Questions on As You Like It
summary: Exercises based on As You Like It extracts where learners evaluate statements about Orlando's love, Rosalind's disguise and their encounter, arrange four key events in chronological order, and answer five questions about the scene.

title: As You Like It Section 3: Reordering Orlando's Speech and Creative Writing Task
summary: Learners rearrange jumbled lines of Orlando's poetic speech about Rosalind into coherent order, then write a short paragraph imagining an alternative ending to the scene where Rosalind reveals herself to Orlando.

title: Literature Focus Section 4: Event Ordering and Comprehension Questions on As You Like It
summary: Four events from the As You Like It extracts must be placed in the correct sequence, followed by seven comprehension questions about Phoebe's reactions, her feelings for Ganymede, and Ganymede's advice to both Phoebe and Silvius.

title: As You Like It Section 4: Matching Characters, Old English Vocabulary and a Letter from Phoebe
summary: Learners match four characters with their actions in the extracts, identify old English equivalents for five modern words, and write a short creative letter in which Phoebe confesses her love to Ganymede.

title: Literature Focus Section 5: Multiple Choice and True/False on As You Like It Extracts About Orlando and Oliver
summary: Six multiple-choice questions test understanding of Orlando saving Oliver from a lioness and Rosalind's reaction, followed by five true/false statements covering the details of the fight, Oliver's transformation and Orlando's wound.

title: As You Like It Section 5: Event Ordering, Summary Completion and a Letter from Oliver
summary: The remaining true/false statements about Orlando and Oliver are completed, then learners order six events from the brotherly reunion, fill in a summary of the scene, and write a letter as Oliver recounting what happened to Frederick.
